rows.market_wrap: The Nifty fell 277 points (1.07%) to 25,607 and the Sensex 989 points to 83,339, snapping a four-week winning run, as Brent crude neared $98, the rupee weakened toward ₹92.9 per dollar and proposed US tariffs on trading partners including India weighed; IT led the losses (HCL Tech, Infosys and TCS down about 2.5–2.8%). Broader markets held up, with the Nifty Smallcap 100 up 0.56%.
